sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bìxū cānjiā měi cì huìyì.
sentences.scenario: Explain your meeting obligations at work.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated use of 一定 for obligation and confusion between 开会 and 会议.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yídìng yào shàng Zhōngwén kè.
sentences.scenario: Make Chinese class a firm commitment.
sentences.source_note: Analysis gives this variation to practice obligation with 一定要.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò yào zuò.
sentences.english_hint: I have a lot of work to do.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我要很多工作 when describing an existing workload.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge huìyì yào cānjiā.
sentences.english_hint: I have a meeting to attend.
sentences.source_note: Analysis variation combines the core 有……要…… structure with the meeting chunk.

sentences.chinese: 我忘了今天还有中文课。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le jīntiān hái yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
sentences.english_hint: I forgot I had Chinese class today.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you nearly missed class.
sentences.source_note: Corrects word order in the learner's explanation about forgetting class.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng cuòguò Zhōngwén kè.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you need to attend class.
sentences.source_note: Repeated difficulty producing miss; analysis corrects 错 to the complete word 错过.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān bú yòng gōngzuò.
sentences.english_hint: I thought I didn't have to work today.
sentences.scenario: Explain your mistaken assumption about the holiday.
sentences.source_note: Shortens the analysis correction of 今天不是工作 while preserving the learner's intent.

sentences.chinese: 我想试试不看拼音读课文。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shìshi bú kàn pīnyīn dú kèwén.
sentences.english_hint: I want to try reading without pinyin.
sentences.scenario: Suggest a reading exercise during Chinese class.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects the learner's request to read the text without looking at pinyin.

sentences.scenario: Ask for feedback after suggesting a study exercise.
sentences.source_note: Corrects recurring 你觉得什么 when asking for an opinion.

sentences.chinese: 如果明天有中文课，我就早点起床。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān yǒu Zhōngwén kè, wǒ jiù zǎodiǎn qǐchuáng.
sentences.english_hint: If I have Chinese class tomorrow, I'll get up earlier.
sentences.scenario: Plan your morning around a possible class.
sentences.source_note: Analysis variation connects the conditional pattern with getting up and attending class.

sentences.chinese: 虽然今天是假期，但是我还有中文课。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán jīntiān shì jiàqī, dànshì wǒ hái yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
sentences.english_hint: Although today is a holiday, I still have Chinese class.
sentences.scenario: Explain why your holiday morning includes class.
sentences.source_note: Analysis model reflects the learner's holiday and forgotten Chinese class.

sentences.chinese: 这份工作不但工资高，而且福利也很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò bú dàn gōngzī gāo, érqiě fúlì yě hěn hǎo.
sentences.english_hint: This job has both high pay and good benefits.
sentences.scenario: Describe two advantages of a job in the lesson exercise.
sentences.source_note: Analysis model reinforces the addition pattern and vocabulary repeatedly encountered in reading.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì shí nián qián de wǒ.
sentences.english_hint: This is me ten years ago.
sentences.scenario: Point yourself out in an old photograph.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated 十年以后 when showing a photograph from ten years earlier.

sentences.scenario: Explain that your sister is younger.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 她很小了; omits the uncertain age difference.
